dogecoin.text: ✅ Shiba Inu marketed itself as the “Dogecoin killer” and introduced features like staking and NFTs to add utility.
✅ Dogecoin was created in 2013 as a parody of Bitcoin but became a top cryptocurrency after endorsements from figures like Elon Musk.

Broader Context: Meme Coins in the Crypto Market

Meme coins have been a significant trend in the cryptocurrency space since the rise of Dogecoin in 2020-2021, followed by other popular tokens like Shiba Inu, Floki, and Pepe.

✅ The crocodile mascot in the image reinforces the playful branding. Many meme coins use animal mascots (e.g., Dogecoin with a Shiba Inu, Shiba Inu with a similar dog, or Floki with a Viking-themed dog) to create a recognizable and community-friendly identity.
